exposure: type of surgical repair (open hernioplasty, anatomical repair, laparoscopic hernioplasty)
cohort: Patients aged over 15 years with herniation at the site of a previous surgical scar.
finding: Laparoscopic mesh repair, despite requiring more operating time and skill, is associated with less blood loss, shorter hospital stays, and lower recurrence rates compared to other surgical procedures for abdominal wall hernias.
